Good overall, very entertaining that this hit the scene right before ChatGPT and Co. barged into the scene IRL. It got a lot of stuff right, but it completely missed a lot of things as well.<br>
<br>
Pacing is a bit slow, and it can get a bit... Well, the game dumbs things down for you too much at times. But still interesting, and a bit emotional at times as well.
